name: GOLF (FOUR CARD)
description: Four-card Golf: 2+ players, 52 cards. Each has 4 cards in a square, two visible once. Draw or take discard to replace; knock to end hand. Lowest score wins. Also Turtle, Polish Poker Four Card.

content.text: Four-card Golf: 2+ players, 52 cards. Each has 4 cards in a square, two visible once. Draw or take discard to replace; knock to end hand. Lowest score wins. Also Turtle, Polish Poker Four Card.

Golf is widespread in North America, Britain, and other English-speaking countries but seldom appears in card game books. The object is to score as little as possible, as in the sport of golf; end-of-hand scores are often likened to strokes per hole. The game is commonly played over 9 or 18 deals (holes). The four-card form is also known as Turtle and as Polish Poker (Polish Polka).
Standard 52-card pack. With eight or more players, two packs may be shuffled together.
4 cards each, 2x2; look at 2 once. Stock and discard.

items.text: Pairs in row or column score zero: Pair of equal cards in the same row or column scores zero for that pair; diagonally opposite equal cards do not cancel.
Knocker penalty 10 points: If the player who knocks does not have the lowest score, they add a penalty of 10 points to their score for that hand.
